blurb: The Hollis Equestrian Park property is owned by the Town of Hollis. It was formerly the town dump and as such is subject to sink holes that must filled every spring by the Friends of the Hollis Equestrian Park. The Friends of the Hollis Equestrian Park is a non-profit organization registered with the State of Maine. The Friends of the Hollis Equestrian Park has a multi-year lease with the Town of Hollis to operate
